full_rule: pre before first drift window; drift inside union of drift windows; post elsewhere after first window
event_selection: NEM plus region-specific events; full-stream buffered windows must overlap evaluated stream
local_rule: 7-day pre; documented event drift; 7-day post; outside excluded; priority drift > pre > post (independent of buffer_mode)
interval_method: seed-specific fixed regional conformal radius transferred to each adaptation point forecast
selection_note: Primary configurations retained from previous analysis; not newly selected using these regime results.
rolling_mae: Not regenerated; rolling errors do not change when only regime labels change.
